name: index_correlated_breakout_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, whenever a bar closes above the running intraday session high, it signals that institutional VWAP-benchmarked algorithms that were patiently accumulating on earlier dips have finally absorbed all intraday supply — their execution models flip from 'passive fill' to 'active momentum' mode. This creates a cascade of order flow that typically extends 15-25 NIFTY spot points over the next 30-90 seconds. The edge is highest when: (1) the breakout occurs above VWAP — confirming the institutional side of the ledger is net-long for the session — and (2) a 1-minute momentum buildup precedes the new high, distinguishing a sustained institutional push from a retail spike that fails within 2-3 bars. Session-high breakouts that occur mid-session (after 09:30, when all opening range noise has cleared) carry stronger institutional weight than ORB breakouts because they overcome all intraday supply that accumulated post-open.
core_signal_oneliner: New intraday session high/low breakout with VWAP alignment, 1-minute momentum buildup, and volume surge
